risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain duration flexibility; favor short-duration bonds; hold quality equities with pricing power; monitor August CPI release closely
Hedge energy exposure; favor energy producers over consumers; monitor Iraq/China dynamics; consider energy ETFs as tactical allocation
Diversify beyond mega-cap AI; focus on companies with revenue realization (TSM, ENTG) over pure narrative plays; set profit-taking levels
Avoid distressed airlines (Frontier), struggling retailers (Gap); monitor Cerba restructuring; maintain liquidity buffer
Monitor Warren/Sanders legislative proposals; assess PE sector exposure; track Huawei legal proceedings for tech supply chain implications

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain cash/short-duration allocation for opportunistic deployment
defensive_moves.rationale: High rates make cash attractive (4.1-4.35%); volatility from oil, rates, and geopolitics creates buying opportunities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid overconcentration in single AI narrative
defensive_moves.rationale: High expectations leave stocks vulnerable (Noviskis); AMD Wall Street concern; diversify across AI beneficiaries

market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. August inflation data and Fed rate-hike threat dominate. Oil volatility and corporate earnings (Oracle) add noise. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy and defensives. EM strength may continue but US stocks face headwinds from oil and rate uncertainty.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive. AI infrastructure buildout (TSM, Nvidia) supports multi-year earnings growth. EM capital formation (India, Africa IPOs) signals global growth confidence. Energy transition and copper demand support materials sector. Elevated rates normalize over 6-12 months. Key risk: if inflation proves sticky, prolonged tight policy could compress valuations.
